result.topic_en: Draft passages for Riemann's study of trigonometric series: examples of series whose coefficients tend to zero (Σ c_s cos s²x, Σ c_s sin s²x, and a logarithmic series in q = e^{xi}) that converge or diverge at rational values of x/2π or are not integrable, and the twice-integrated series F(x); the inverted lower part holds draft notes on convergence conditions that refer to Art. 15, 16.

methods.what: Example of trigonometric series with quadratic frequencies and monotonically decreasing positive coefficients tending to zero but with divergent sum; whether they converge at rational x/2π is decided by Gauss-type sums
methods.quote:
dass für einen rationalen Werth $\frac{m}{n}$ von $\frac{x}{2\pi}$ diese Reihen
convergiren oder aber jede Grösse wachsen, je nachdem $\sum \cos s^2 x$,
$\sum_{1,n} \sin s^2 x$ Null oder nicht

methods.what: Grouping partial sums into blocks of n terms (struck-out)
methods.quote: $\sum_{t,t+nk-1} c_s \cos s^2 x = \sum_{t,t+n-1} c_s \cos s^2 x + \sum_{t+n,t+2n-1} + \sum_{t+2n,t+3n-1} \cdots \sum_{t+kn-n,t+kn-1}$

methods.what: Example of a series in powers of q = e^{xi}, with coefficients tending to zero, whose term-by-term integral has a nowhere-integrable real part
Twice term-by-term integrated trigonometric series F(x), continuous and finite everywhere
methods.quote: $Fx = g + hx + \frac{1}{4} b_0 x^2 - a_1 \frac{\sin x}{1^2} - a_2 \frac{\sin 2x}{2^2} \cdots$

items.english: It can easily be shown that, for a rational value m/n of x/2π, these series converge or else grow beyond every quantity, according as the sums Σ cos s²x, Σ_{1,n} sin s²x are zero or not.

items.quote:
Dasselbe gilt auch noch von der Reihe, welche man aus {+der gegebenen+} $\Omega$
durch Integration jedes Gliedes nach x erhält.
items.english: The same also holds for the series obtained from the given Ω by integrating each term with respect to x.

items.quote:
während sie nach x integrirt {+in reellen Werthen von x+}
eine Function liefert, deren reeller Theil [-für-] [-offenbar-] nirgends eine Integration zulässt.
items.english: ...whereas, integrated with respect to x for real values of x, it yields a function whose real part nowhere admits an integration.

items.quote:
welche für jeden Werth von x endlich und stetig ist und also
stets durchgehends eine Integration zulässt.
items.english: which is finite and continuous for every value of x and therefore always admits an integration throughout.
